'''Twisted Spinal Signals''' are a [[:Category:Drops|Drop]] and a [[:Category:Drops#Lure Components|Lure Component]] used to craft [[Lures|Concentrated Lures]].

== ''Obtainment'' ==
* Dropped by breaking [[Bladder Sac|Bladder Sacs]] found in the [[Parasite Biome]], with a 5% Drop rate per Sac.
* Smelted from [[Pestilential Ore]], which is generated when [[Beckon|Beckons]] infest [[Remains|Parasite Remains]], or when [[Infested Bonemeal]] is used twice over any Ore<ref>Any Vanilla or Modded ore, with the exception of Vanilla Coal.</ref>.
* Found in [[Parasitic Growth Block|Metastatic Masses]].
